verdict.rationale: The official README shows a first-party `--include-directories` flag that takes a comma-separated list of extra project directories (e.g. ../lib,../docs), so one session can span several directories. The evidence is a single command example with no deeper documentation. Missing for 10: documented behavior and limits of multi-directory context (e.g. how many directories, how they combine with GEMINI.md), an in-session way to add directories, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-directory use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context
